editor: [Improved] Usertour Helper embed link updated to force cache invalidation

launcher: [New] Icon picker supporting built-in Remix icon presets, URL-based icons, and custom uploads for greater launcher customization (merged from upstream)

conditions: [New] Page Name condition allowing flows and launchers to trigger based on the current page name

editor: [New] Skip step action added to the editor, allowing users to bypass steps or exit flows with controlled behavior
launcher: [Fixed] Overlay detection causing launchers to incorrectly be treated as hidden when covered by dynamic elements
[Improved] Launcher visibility detection for partially off-screen or dynamically rendered elements
[Fixed] Launcher detaching and reattaching incorrectly during scroll events
[Fixed] Launcher button action type not being saved correctly in the builder
environment: [Fixed] Docker layer and docker-compose.yml configuration issues affecting local environments

iframe-sdk: [New] Dedicated launcher rendering pipeline for iframe contexts with accurate positioning and scroll handling
[Fixed] Popper/tooltip positioning issues for elements inside scrollable iframes
[Fixed] Trigger conditions not consistently firing when driven by DOM or navigation events
environment: [Improved] Removed verbose debug logging from SDK core modules to improve runtime performance

conditions: [New] isVisible and !isVisible conditions supporting both main window and iframe contexts for more precise targeting
launcher: [Fixed] Launcher failing to attach to elements inside modals or dynamically rendered containers
[Improved] Attachment retry strategy for DOM element targeting, reducing premature or repeated retries
security: [Improved] Password reset emails also printed to terminal in development environments for debugging

editor: [New] Plugins page for installing selector tools and embedding the Usertour SDK
[Improved] Draft content visibility and environment handling in content listings
security: [Improved] Signup flow updates including routing fixes, stronger password requirements, and improved registration UX
environment: [Improved] Build configuration updates across apps/server and apps/sdk

iframe-sdk: [New] SDK support for content running inside iframes, including cross-frame communication utilities, selector parsing, and integration documentation
